parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to start the next query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
The resource ID. You can specify up to 50 entries.

> - This parameter is conditionally required. You must specify at least one ResourceId.N value. If ResourceType is set to ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE, the value of ResourceId corresponds to the Resources[].Resource field returned by the [DescribeDefenseResources](~~461612~~) operation.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags. You can specify up to 20 entries.
